tei:div.tei:p: Halleluyah. For the Lord is good, sing to our God for He is pleasant, praise is becoming. The builder of Jerusalem is the Lord, the dispersed of Israel will He gather together. It is He who heals the broken-hearted and binds their wounds. He counts the number of the stars and calls all of them by name. Great is our Lord, abundant of power, His understanding is beyond measure. A supporter of the humble is the Lord, He casts down the wicked to the ground. Respond to the Lord with gratitude, play to our God upon the harp. He who covers heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on mountains, He gives the beast its food, to the young ravens when they call out. He delights not in the might of the horse nor takes pleasure in the legs of a man. The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him, in those who wait for His grace. Extol the Lord, O Jerusalem, praise your God, O Zion. For He has strengthened the breaches of your gates, He has blessed your children in your midst. Peace has He placed in your border and satisfied you with rich wheat. He sends forth His command upon the earth, very swiftly does His word run. He grants snow like wool and scatters frost like dust. He hurls down His ice like morsels of bread, who can stand before His cold. He sends His word to melt them, causes His wind to blow and water flows. He tells His words to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel. He did not do this to any other nation, they do not know His judgments. Halleluyah.
